lines: {player}: Nina! A girl from the pond says she's you!
A me? From the pond?
She's not me. Just another Nina. Not a nice one.
Go find her at the pond. I'll wait here.
She went back? Good. I feel a bit sorry for her.
{player}! Look! It's SNOWING!
It never snows here. Not ever!
Let's build a snowman! Get a carrot from Kip...
...and Prue's red scarf by our door. Meet me on the green!
{player}! The sun's actually HOT!
BEACH DAY! At Willow Pond!
Get Prue's swim ring and a bucket from Hank. Meet me by the dock!
{player}! Rain AND flowers! It's spring!
But Mother Duck's lost her five ducklings!
Find them, they'll follow you. Go go go!
You turned the stone dial by the oak? The town went WHOOSH!
Prue wants to turn it every five minutes.
A carrot from Kip, Prue's scarf from our door. Hurry!
You got them! Roll the big ball! It's right here.
My sled's on top of Lookout Hill. You go first!
That was a TEN! Now ask Gus for cocoa!
Prue named our snowman Sir Carrots.
Swim ring from our door, bucket from Hank's. Then the beach!
You got them! You dig, I'll do the towers!
Best sandcastle EVER! Now cannonball off the dock!
A TEN! I'm soaked. Ask Gus for pink lemonade!
Prue put a crab in charge of our castle. Well, a pebble.
Find five ducklings round town. Walk up to them!
They're following you! Take them to Mother Duck.
They're home! Now jump in the three puddles on the green!
I'm SO wet. Honey buns at Poppy's!
Prue named all the ducklings Gerald.
Oh! Hi! Good morning! I'm Nina, from Maple Lane.
{player}: Hi Nina! I'm {player}.
Do you ever feel like something BIG is coming? No? Just me!
Go meet everyone! Mr. Palmer's by the gazebo.
Mr. Palmer's at the gazebo. He waves a lot.
And say hi to two more people!
You met everyone! Now look at this.
The notice board! Press {interact} on it.
Follow a job and a star shows the way!
Then come back here for sparkles!
Best first day! I have to go home for dinner now.
Huh. Did the stars just... flicker?
See you tomorrow, {player}!
{player}! Did you FALL too?
Me too! Right through my bedroom floor!
And we both got watches. 'Chosen'... for WHAT?
Will it happen again?
Midnight, then!
Me too!
Want me to show you round again? From the start?
Yay! Say hi to Mr. Palmer first!
Okay! It's in your quests any time.
Oh. Hey. I'm Nina.
{player}: Nina? You look... different.
Different from what? ...Not here.
The Frost Fair! I've had five cocoas!
Watch the lanterns at nine. They go green over the oak!
The Summer Fair! My tongue's every colour!
Watch the lanterns at ten. They go green over the oak!
The festival! I've had five caramel apples!
Watch the lanterns at nine. They go green over the oak!
The Spring Fair! I've had five strawberry tarts!
Watch the lanterns at nine. They go green over the oak!
The tree's bigger every year!
Make a wish when the star lights up!
Mine's the red kite with the black bow.
Real fireflies AND fireworks! Best night!
Happy Hallow's Eve! I'm a vampire. Bruno's a meatball.
No school today! Bruno's had four pancakes.
Gus does a snowflake grilled cheese. Kind of.
Gus does a sunshine grilled cheese. Kind of.
Gus does a pumpkin grilled cheese. Kind of.
Gus does a flower grilled cheese. Kind of.
The pond goes so still. Like it's listening.
I'm saving up for Otis's telescope.
The oak hums louder at night. You noticed too?
My room! Red and black. Dramatic!
Skating with Bruno. He's better. For now.
Prue built a cereal box fort!
